verdict.rationale: Stable publishes a per-endpoint API reference under docs.usestable.com/reference, covering authentication, location onboarding sessions, signature packets and company deactivation, plus an llms.txt. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable "try it" examples, and the probe found no public OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it or runnable request consoles, code samples per endpoint, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
